info.title: My Oni Girl
info.synopsis: L'incapacità di un timido adolescente di dire di no è messa alla prova quando una tenace ragazza lo porta in un viaggio mistico tra la neve estiva per trovare la madre scomparsa.

info.title: Laidbackers
info.synopsis: La storia si svolge nella Kyoto contemporanea. Kumi, una studentessa di belle arti, si trasferisce in città per prendere in gestione il negozio di dolciumi ereditato dalla nonna, assieme ad una casa, sulla carta disabitata, ma in realtà occupata da tre donne (Harami Mino, K Kusanagi e Mai Maisaka) ed un cane. Kumi si ritrova a convivere con loro, auto-dichiaratesi eroi reincarnati in questo periodo storico, allo scopo di dare la caccia al Re dei Demoni! Un bel giorno appare il re dei demoni, reincarnatosi in una bambina delle elementari, che chiede l'aiuto del gruppo per recuperare i frammenti dei propri poteri magici. L'aiuteranno nell'impresa?

info.title: Boku wa Imouto ni Koi wo Suru
info.synopsis: Yori e Iku sono due gemelli, sin da piccoli si sono sempre voluti un gran bene e hanno sempre dimostrato reciprocamente il loro affetto. Ad un certo punto Yori diventa brusco e freddo, il motivo è che si è innamorato della sorella e per non causare problemi vorrebbe andarsene in una scuola più lontana.

info.title: Devilman (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il demone Devilman si impossessa del corpo del giovane Akira Fudo, deceduto insieme al padre durante un'escursione nell'Himalaya. Sebbene il suo compito sia quello di diffondere il caos nel mondo degli umani per poi conquistarlo, Devilman si innamora di una ragazza, Miki Makimura e il suo sentimento lo porta a rinnegare la stirpe demoniaca e a combattere contro gli altri demoni pur di proteggere la sua amata.

episodes.title: Rinasce la stirpe delle tenebre
episodes.synopsis: Il Grande Zenon ordina a tre demoni di combattere fino alla morte. Il vincitore sceglierà un umano, Akira Fudo, assumendone l'identità per gettare panico e sofferenze sul pianeta terra.

episodes.title: L'Arpia Silen
episodes.synopsis: Il Grande Zenon convoca Silen per parlare con Devilman e vedere se ha davvero tradito il Clan del Diavolo.

episodes.title: Geruge, la bestia demoniaca
episodes.synopsis: Xenon sends the slug-type demon Gelge to kill Devilman.

episodes.title: Zannin, il generale diabolico
episodes.synopsis: Demon General Xannin is selected to takeover Devilman's original mission. He dispatches to Japan with Demon Vetra.

episodes.title: Zoldover, la bella addormentata
episodes.synopsis: A new student, Himura Iwao, arrives at Nakado Academy and challenges Akira to a race. During which, they stumble upon a cave and discover a sleeping woman. The woman is actually Lita, who was a human sympathizer from the Demon Tribe.

episodes.title: Il collo di Rockfel
episodes.synopsis: Miki's father works to reconstruct the face of the skull of a young woman who died 200 years ago. Rokfel animates the skull and begins to wreak havoc in the city to lure out Devilman.

episodes.title: Zool, lo spaventoso burattinaio
episodes.synopsis: Puppeteer Zulu and Demon Abil set their sights on Miki.

episodes.title: Lyamon e Bawoo
episodes.synopsis: Demon Iyamon disguises herself as a student in order to kill Miki. When her cover is blown by Devilman, her brother Bauu comes to her rescue.

episodes.title: Gondoroma, il demone delle onde cerebrali
episodes.synopsis: Brainwave Demon Gondroma uses his powers to control animals and spread chaos in the human world.

episodes.title: Gande, l'occhio che cammina
episodes.synopsis: Devilman faces off against the Gan Triplets.

episodes.title: Lafleur, il demone fiore scarlatto
episodes.synopsis: While pursuing Demon Lafleur, Devilman accidentally injures Miki's father. Akira and Miki get into a huge argument, and it seems as though their relationship is over.

episodes.title: Faiam, il demone infuocato
episodes.synopsis: The mischievous demon Firem accompanies the behemoth Aguilar on his mission with Xannin. Devilman finally has a one-on-one match with Xannin.

episodes.title: Mermaime, l'arrogante
episodes.synopsis: Xenon dispatches Demon Mermaim to assist Xannin in his fight against Devilman. She does not care for Xannin, and puts a spell on him to prevent his interference. Mermaim moves in and attacks the Makimura family while they are on vacation. As Devilman does battle with Mermaim, Xannin discovers Miki.

episodes.title: Sfida nel Regno dei Ghiacci
episodes.synopsis: Miki is rushed to the hospital after an altercation with Xannin. Furious, and heartbroken, Devilman swears to defeat the Demon Tribe once and for all. He flies to the Himalayas to settle things with Xenon, only to find the Tribe is gone. Himura appears and finally reveals his true identity.

episodes.title: Ebain, il demone dalle mille braccia
episodes.synopsis: The centaur-type, horned demon Evine uses mirrors to control people's arms.

episodes.title: Jenny, il demone che vive nell'ombra
episodes.synopsis: During a meteor shower, all of the children in town start seeing a glowing red star. They soon begin receiving terrible nightmares and are driven to the point of insanity.

episodes.title: Dagon, il demone dei francobolli
episodes.synopsis: Akira, Miki, Tare, and his friends come across a mysterious storyteller. The storyteller gives children stamps with monster designs on them. At night, the monsters come to life and attack.

episodes.title: Mayako, il demone d'argento
episodes.synopsis: A beautiful young woman named Mayako begins working at Cafe Chaco. Her alluring beauty has smitten all of the males in town. When young boys start killing themselves over Mayako, Akira wonders if there's more behind her allure.

episodes.title: Adal, lo stratega dei manichini
episodes.synopsis: Tare comes across a dumping ground with tons of mannequins. Later at night, he sees a mannequin in his room and attacks it with a hammer. It turns out the mannequin was Miki, who was killed by his attack. Distressed, Tare runs away from home.

episodes.title: Addio, demone Dorango
episodes.synopsis: A new transfer student named Tomita arrives at Nakado Academy and takes a liking to Miki. This angers Akira, who views Tomita as a rival.

episodes.title: Doro, il demone goloso di umani
episodes.synopsis: Demon Draw has a bottomless appetite and sets his eyes on Nakado Academy.

episodes.title: Mugal, il demone illusionista
episodes.synopsis: Principal Pochi and Alphonne see Akira push Miki into a river. Akira is set on proving his innocence and finding Miki.

episodes.title: Bella, il demone del Tibet
episodes.synopsis: Tare has a fight with Miyo and ends up stowing away on his father's flight to Tibet. Akira and Miki go off to bring him back home. Meanwhile, Demon General Muxan enlists Bera to expand the Demon Tribe's territory. She reworks her plan to eliminate Akira and the Makimura family.

episodes.title: Demone Jakon, il fantasma vivente
episodes.synopsis: Demon Giacon uses his powers of possession to wreak havoc in the human world.

episodes.title: Muzan, il Generale demoniaco, attacca la scuola
episodes.synopsis: Tired of his failures, Muxan decides to go face Devilman himself. All of Nakado Academy is held captive in an alternate dimension.

episodes.title: Lala, il demone delle nevi
episodes.synopsis: Akira is captured by Demons Dodo and Demon Lala during a ski trip. Dodo disguises himself as Akira and plans on killing all of his friends.

episodes.title: Jewel, il demone dei desideri oltre ogni limite
episodes.synopsis: Demon Lord Xenon places Demon Marshall Lacock in charge of operations. Meanwhile, Lala attempts to escape the insane asylum.

episodes.title: Miniyon, il demone del medaglione diabolico
episodes.synopsis: Lacock sends out her second servant, Miniyon to wreak havoc in the human world. He leaves his special pendant everywhere, which has the power to shrink anyone. Lala attempts to seduce Akira, much to his annoyance.

episodes.title: Kenetos e il mistero delle collane
episodes.synopsis: Demon Kenetos leaves behind his cursed necklaces all over Japan. Anyone who puts it on, has their head transported into his realm. Akira's teacher Alphonne falls victim to Kenetos' scheme.

episodes.title: Faizel, il demone dell'ombra della follia
episodes.synopsis: Demon Phizele has the ability to turn any human aggressive and violent. Miki, Lala, Tare, and Miyo have to fend off all the crazed humans while Devilman tries to find Phizele.

episodes.title: Kilski, il demone del tornado rosso
episodes.synopsis: Demon Kilskey is dispatched by Lacock to kill Lala. Kilskey later reworks his plan to use Lala to lure Devilman into a trap.

episodes.title: Aurora, il demone della prigione brillante
episodes.synopsis: Demon Marshall Lacock orders Lala's best friend, Aurora, to kill her.

episodes.title: Weathers, il demone della rivolta del sole
episodes.synopsis: Demon Weathers uses his powers of weather control to battle Devilman. Tare and Miyo attempt to save a dog named Hachi.

episodes.title: Alron, il demone dall'abito spaventoso
episodes.synopsis: Upset at the pain Devilman has caused the Demon Marshall, Alron dispatches to Japan to kill him. Meanwhile, Lala is frustrated with her own stupidity and tries to find a way to cure it. Akira mocks her, saying only death can fix that. Lala attempts to kill herself, ultimately throwing herself at battle with Alron.

episodes.title: Il Maresciallo diabolico Reicock e la scuola congelata
episodes.synopsis: Mourning the loss of Alron, Demon Marshall Lacock disobeys Xenon's orders and goes to confront Devilman. She uses her powers to slow down time in the city, leaving only Akira and Lala out of the trance. Together, they battle against Lacock.

episodes.title: Magdora, il demone della lava volante
episodes.synopsis: Lala is killed by Demon Magdler. Devilman fights him to get revenge.

episodes.title: Wood-Do, il demone delle piante folli
episodes.synopsis: Demon Wooddou controls trees to attack humanity. While battling against Wooddou, Akira transforms in front of Tare.

episodes.title: Demone Dreamoon: la Luna è inferno
episodes.synopsis: Demon Dremoon is using his powers to bring the Earth closer to the Moon. Devilman frantically searches for Dremoon before it's too late.

episodes.title: God, il demone dei miracoli divini
episodes.synopsis: A series of unexplained events have been occurring all over the world. Akira realizes the only person who has such power is Xenon's Captain of Guard: Demon God. God warns Akira not to interfere, otherwise, he will reveal his identity to Miki.

info.title: Magic Maker: How to Make Magic in Another World
info.synopsis: Gli Ornstein sono una famiglia di nobili minori che governano una zona rurale nel regno di Listia e hanno due figli. Marie, la sorella maggiore, è energica ed adora essere allenata nell'arte della spada dal padre mentre Shion, il fratello minore, è timido e passa la maggior parte del tempo a leggere libri nella sua stanza. I due hanno caratteri completamente opposti ma vivono felicemente assieme sotto l'occhio vigile dei loro gentili genitori. Un giorno Shion chiede al padre se esiste qualcosa chiamato "magia" in questo mondo e nonostante il genitore fosse decisamente colto non aveva mai sentito questo termine. Da quel giorno in poi il ragazzo diventò visibilmente depresso e Marie, preoccupata per le condizioni del fratello, chiede consiglio alla sua amica d'infanzia Rose su come aiutarlo. Portato al lago Shion si imbatte in un misterioso fenomeno che sembra tanto la "magia" di cui parlava e si riaccendono le speranze in lui facendogli prendere una decisione: inizierà a fare ricerche riguardo la "magia", diventandone il pioniere in questo mondo!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Marie absolutely adores her younger brother Shion, everything from the way he secretly plays pretend to the oddly grown-up look he gets sometimes. One day, he asks their father about something called "magic" and their whole lives change.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: After yearning for magic throughout his first life, Shion lives his second life in another world without magic. But his sister's discovery at a lake has given him hope. As he researches the luminous phenomenon, he feels his dream stir back to life.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Goblins are sighted near the village. Gawain goes to hunt them while Shion and others from the village hide in the mansion for protection. Suddenly, there's a pounding at the door and a window shatters—a goblin has broken into the mansion.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Shion's father finally approves of his magic research, which leads Shion to a new discovery. Marie seems troubled as she devotes herself to her sword.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Shion and Marie's relationship is mostly back to normal. Now, Grast has a problem that only Shion can solve.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Left shaken by his father's words, Shion continues his research by taking it into the field to hunt monsters.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Two years after Shion and the others' first monster hunt, a mysterious red light flashes through the clouds.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Marie is gravely ill and strange monsters have attacked. Shion is determined to do everything he can to help.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Shion devotes himself to finding a cure for lethargy sickness. Rose, worried for her friends, offers to help.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The night menace appears once more. Shion and the others race out to defend Istria from horde of wraiths.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Ainswelf's arrival changes everything. Shion steps up to challenge a foe far more powerful than himself.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Exhausted from the battle, Shion sleeps for a week. He wakes to concerned faces and a mysterious phenomenon.

info.synopsis: Spin-Off del franchise dell'anime calcistico di Inazuma Eleven. Il primo episodio presenta i fratelli Fubuki.

info.title: Merman in my Tub
info.synopsis: Tatsumi è uno studente delle superiori piuttosto figo ma anche un po’ ficcanaso che vive da solo in un proprio appartamento. Un giorno però la sua quotidianità viene sconvolta dall’arrivo di Wakasa, un affascinante esemplare di sirena ma di sesso maschile, che si piazza a vivere nella vasca da bagno.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: High school student Tatsumi lives alone. One day he spots a person while walking by a river. He approaches the figure and discovers a beautiful man collapsed on the ground.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Wakasa begins living in Tatsumi's bathtub. Just having a merman live in his home is difficult enough, but another major problem arises: the living expenses including water for Wakasa!

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: One weekend morning as Tatsumi heads to the bathroom with breakfast, he hears lively voices coming from inside.The puzzled Tatsumi opens the bathroom door and discovers a mysterious octopus? No, it's Wakasa's friend Takasu.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Tatsumi informs Wakasa and Takasu of a rumor about a ghost appearing in a nearby park. Behind Tatsumi, a mysterious white object appears... The white shadow tells a surprised Tatsumi, "Nice to meet you. My name is Mikuni."

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: A witch, a vampire, and a mummy... From the darkness, Wakasa, Takasu, and Mikuni appear.When Tatsumi sees Wakasa dressed as a witch, he wonders why. When Mikuni declares, "Trick or Treat," he realizes it's Halloween, but he tells the trio he has no candy. The watchful trio pounces on Tatsumi with a tickle attack! What will happen to Tatsumi? Will Wakasa and his friends acquire any candy?

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Wakasa reads his magazines as usual. He had become obsessed with the female fantasy of taking a bubble bath. When Tatsumi enters the bathroom, drags Wakasa out of the tub. Wakasa doesn't understand.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: The doorbell rings. A panicked Tatsumi says, "She's here! I'm counting on you," and Wakasa responds by giving him a thumbs up and saying, "Leave it to me!"

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: One day at dinner after Wakasa is finished eating, Tatsumi finds leftover bell peppers and carrots on his plate. When Tatsumi asks why he doesn't eat vegetables, Wakasa responds being a carnivore is the current trend.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Wakasa is shocked when Tatsumi leans over the tub and announces it stinks. Tatsumi cleans the tub responsible for the odor and transfers Wakasa to a children's pool. Saying, "Brother, tell me if you're using the pool," Kasumi mistakes Wakasa for Tatsumi and hugs him.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Some schoolboys are making a commotion in front of Tatsumi's apartment. They leave immediately when Tatsumi calls out to them. Looking down, Tatsumi discovers a conch rolling near his feet.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: When Wakasa asks if something good happened, Tatsumi shyly admits his manager gave him a raise and allows Wakasa to splurge a little. Wakasa grins at Tatsumi's offer to splurge, and Tatsumi buys Wakasa a massive amount of milk. While Wakasa enjoys his milk bath, Mikuni, Maki, and Takasu arrive...

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Wakasa gets nervous when Tatsumi is late coming home and gets out of the tub to look around the house, causing a mess and nearly drying out. When Tatsumi comes home, he thanks Wakasa for worrying about him, but makes him promise not to get out of the tub next time, or else he won't give Wakasa the cake he brought with him.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Wakasa worries that Tatsumi may kick him out after watching a man complaining about his partner's moocher tendencies on TV, and asks Tatsumi to help him find a job. Because Wakasa has nothing to put on a resume, Tatsumi recommends that he enter by-mail sweepstakes, but Wakasa is unable to write kanji and Tatsumi must teach him. Wakasa fills out stacks of postcards, but is shocked that he will not get to see the contest results for a month. Tatsumi reassures Wakasa that he doesn't have to worry about being kicked out, because they are friends. Wakasa mainly enters contests to win free meat, but what he receives at the end of the month is a scarf, which he had been aiming for to give to Tatsumi. During the credits, Wakasa's friends come over for a New Year's party, and Kasumi also has a brief appearance wishing her brother a happy new year from her own house.
